hypothesised_pattern: Class_2 appears when x4^2 clearly exceeds 1 and |x2*x5| is not large, and all other rows follow the sign of x2*x5 between class_1 and class_0.
functional_form_guess: if x4^2 - 0.4*|x2*x5| > 1 then class_2, else if x2*x5 > 0 then class_1, else class_0
rationale: Rows 2, 6 and 7 are class_2 with |x4| of at least 1.22 and |x2*x5| below 0.75. Row 0 has |x4| of 1.11 but a product near -5.7 and is class_0, which a plain |x4| cut would miss, and the other six rows have |x4| below 0.72 and follow the sign rule.
